title: 建築設備総論
subtitle: Introduction of Building Equipment
teachers:
NAGANO Shinichiro
授業科目の学習・教育目標
keywords: Water supply and drainage sanitary installation
educationalGoal:
It's learned about important air conditioning and building equipment in general of ventilating installation and water supply and drainage sanitary installation by building equipment and the ability which can be applied to an equipment design is learned through a problem and a practice.
Air current analysis technology is learned by a practice as air streaming design technique based on data science for aerial environmental improvement.
advice:
Building equipment in general is explained by the lecture focusing on air conditioning among the building equipment, ventilating installation and water supply and drainage sanitary installation and basic terminology and concept of building equipment in general are understood by a practice.
A practice of a way of thinking with a basic equipment design is performed based on those. The damage case and the trial case which have formed by building equipment in general are considered by a lecture and a practice. An analysis of strong winds blowing through the tall buildings by air current analysis technology base on data science is performed and a basic skill of analysis technology is learned to know more construction and aerial relation.
Architecture and building equipment.
Knowledge of an air conditioner and design concept.
Knowledge and design concept of water supply and drainage sanitary installation.
Site electrical facilities and firefighting equipment.
Disaster preventing.
Way of thinking of ventilation design and ventilation design.
Damage example of the building equipment field, precedent and consideration.
Acquisition of air current analysis technology and analysis of strong winds blowing through the tall buildings.
